messages:
Alex: noticing a steady uptick in corrected ECC on pool22 over the past 48h — main offenders gpu3, gpu7, gpu11. This looks like gradual growth not a one-off spike.

Maria: can you paste the grafana panel or a quick snapshot?

Alex: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/infra/gpu-health?panel=22

Alex: 7d snapshot:
``
gpu3: ECC_corrected_total 120 -> 780
gpu7: ECC_corrected_total 95 -> 610
gpu11: ECC_corrected_total 40 -> 420
page_retire_events: gpu3: 3 -> 18
row_remap_count: gpu7: 0 -> 6
```

Jason: any Xid errors or kernel logs? If we have Xid 79/66 traces could be thermal or DIMM issue.

Alex: pulled dmesg from pool22-node12:
``
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 79, PID=2387, GPU=0000:03:00: Die temperature exceeded threshold
[ 1240.112233] nvidia: page retirement triggered on GPU 3, retired pages: 12
```

Maria: pattern: ECC corrected climbs then page retire increments. Not immediate service loss but trending toward failure. Recommend watchlist and preemptive measures.

ops-runner: running a health scan across pool22 in 1h. will apply a NoSchedule taint on affected nodes to avoid new placements.

sre-bot: created incident INC-2026-2207 for pool22 ECC trend. Pager suppressed until we see Xid escalation. :bell:

Jason: did we push any driver/kernel changes last week? We bumped to nvidia-driver 520.56.01 with kernel 5.15.42 on Friday. Could be a regression.

Alex: attaching driver manifest and PCI bus logs to INC-2026-2207 now.

Maria: short runbook proposal:
1) add gpu3/gpu7/gpu11 to the hardware watchlist with hourly diffs
2) soft-drain worker pods on pool22-node12/14/18 if corrected ECC delta > 300 in 24h
3) prep spare cards (we have 4 spares in USW1) and a replacement checklist
4) vendor diag request if page retire events continue after soft-drain

Jason: also keep the last 30 days of `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.volatile,ecc.errors.aggregate` output attached to the incident for trend analysis.

Alex: kicking off live collector: `/opt/infra/bin/gpu-collect --node pool22-node12 --out /tmp/pool22-node12.log`

ops-runner: taints applied: pool22-node12/14/18 -> `gpu-evacuate=true:NoSchedule`

Maria: heads-up: if we lose >10% of pool22 capacity due to drains, route latency-sensitive traffic to usw2. ping routing team if we hit the threshold.

Jason: I'll draft a canary drain plan with rollback steps and list of impacted services and post to the incident thread.

Alex: note from history: similar ECC+page-retire patterns have been DIMM edge cases — not always permanent but replacement usually safest when row remap grows.

Maria: added diag logs and proposed drain timeline to INC-2026-2207. reconvene in 2h after scan results.

sre-bot: INC-2026-2207 updated: health scan complete, 3 nodes flagged for monitoring. next auto-check in 6h.

ops-runner: ping here if you want a repro/stress run against gpu3 for margin testing.

Jason: I'll run a stress loop post-lunch. :coffee:

Alex: uploaded raw logs and collector output to the incident. good catch — closing this slack thread; updates will continue on the incident.
